title: Keyboard focus, movement and actions on cards and rows
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. The final keyboard-interaction design for Work Orders (SQ-15/UX-19) is available.
  5. AUTOMATION note: exact keys are design-pending; verify once the design is finalized.
custom_steps:
1. Using the keyboard only, move focus into a card/row.
  2. Navigate between cards/rows and technician groups/columns.
  3. Press Enter and confirm the defined action.
  4. Press Escape and confirm it cancels the interaction.
  5. Open a dialog and close it; confirm focus returns to the defined place.
  6. Reach the more-actions menu, pin/unpin, and group collapse/expand by keyboard.
  7. Perform a reorder and a reassignment by keyboard.
  8. Confirm opening a work order coexists with dragging.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • There is a defined, working way for keyboard focus to enter a work order card or row (exact keys per final design).
  • There is defined keyboard navigation between cards/rows and technician groups/columns (exact keys per final design).
  • Enter has a defined action (per final design).
  • Escape has a defined way to cancel an interaction (per final design).
  • Focus returns to a defined place after a dialog closes (per final design).
  • The more-actions menu is reachable by keyboard (per final design).
  • Pin and unpin are reachable by keyboard (per final design).
  • Group collapse and expand are reachable by keyboard (per final design).
  • Reordering and reassignment can be done by keyboard (per final design).
  • Opening a work order coexists with dragging via keyboard (per final design).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10054 — Story 11 Keyboard access and focus. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S11-R1, S11-R3, S11-R4, S11-R5, S11-R6, S11-R2, S11-R7, S11-R8, S11-R9, S11-R10 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
